name: DependencyInjection
summary: Has its collaborators handed to it from outside, so that a test can give it something other than what production gives it.

roles.name: DependencyInjection
roles.summary: A participant that never obtains its own collaborators. It is the most common answer to testability and the one that leaves the fewest traces: a class built this way looks like any other, and the fact that it was designed to be substitutable is exactly what nothing in it says.
